Open Governance Directory

Governance Policies & Statutory Rules

UKABCS operates under full statutory and ethical compliance. Each policy document below defines our operational rules.

PUBLISHED

Conflict of Interest Policy

Strict recusal and disclosure requirements for Board members, peer-reviewers, and steering committee participants.

Effective: 2025-01-01 Read Policy
PUBLISHED

Equality, Diversity & Inclusion (EDI) Policy

UKABCS commitment to supporting underrepresented researchers, women in science, and developing country universities.

Effective: 2025-01-01 Read Policy
PUBLISHED

Financial Governance & Audit Policy

Annual financial reporting, non-profit auditing procedures, and transparent accounting rules for academic grant funds.

Effective: 2025-01-01 Read Policy
PUBLISHED

Grant-Making & Allocation Governance Policy

Independent double-blind peer-review guidelines, scoring criteria, and committee rules governing UKABCS research and capacity building grants.

Effective: 2025-01-01 Read Policy
PUBLISHED

Institutional Due Diligence Policy

Verification protocols for partner universities, research institutes, and recipient bank account details before grant disbursement.

Effective: 2025-01-01 Read Policy
PUBLISHED

Privacy Policy & Data Protection

Comprehensive details on how UKABCS collects, processes, and protects member and applicant personal data under UK GDPR regulations.

Effective: 2025-01-01 Read Policy

UKABCS

UK Organisation for Biotechnology and Computational Science (UKABCS) is a UK-registered non-profit academic society dedicated to peer-reviewed research, transparent grant funding, and open-access scientific education.
